pairs.evidence: src/app/api/org/skills/promote/route.ts:3 These routes file a scan-generated SKILL.md into a versioned library, record downloads/adoption and mint API tokens. No agent memory is carried across turns here, and procedure-promotion's precondition (a repeated observed workflow being promoted) does not hold either, because the source is a scan report and not an episode count. A case-insensitive search of src/app/api/org/skills and src/app/api/org/tokens for memory, recall, episod and consolidat found zero hits.
